brief:
Middle East Eye reported that a film titled "Bibi's Department" documents how Israel employed blackmail involving extramarital affairs and sexual orientation to pressure Palestinians. The documentary examines methods used against individuals, including survivors of alleged war crimes in Gaza, according to interviewees featured in the work.

The film suggests Palestinian subjects were regarded as security threats and targeted through personal information as part of coercive intelligence operations.

title: Israel used blackmail on affairs, sexuality to coerce Palestinians, film shows
